newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end firmer on local funds support.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end firmer on local funds support.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip share prices bounced off their recent lows to close over two percent higher on Monday, with support coming in from local funds, dealers and analysts said.
The benchmark Composite Index ended up 21.12 points, or 2.11 percent, to 1,022.67. The small-capitalised Second Board index rose 7.46 points, or 1.41 percent, to 535.26.

"Some locals (funds) are in the market buying key stocks. It could be in celebration of (Prime Minister) Mahathir (Mohamad) returning to Malaysia tomorrow," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage in Kuala Lumpur.
